compound_set.coverage_state_note: compound_thcnm's two required primary queries (`thcnm-liquid-ja` = THCNM リキッド and `tha-liquid-ja` = THA リキッド) each have an adopted run collected on 2026-11-04: declaration metadata/provenance/declarations/20261104-youtube-thcnm-tha-liquid-cannabinoid-raw-collection.json, runs and counts in data-catalog.json. They are two independent runs; their counts are not merged and neither substitutes for the other. Fifteen compounds are registered but have no run: compound_cbc and compound_cbdv (added 2026-11-10 from existing taxonomy concepts) and the thirteen terms added on 2026-11-11 in the administrative category `compound_identity_unverified` (THCB, THCP, THCJD, THCPO, CBE, HHCPO, CBND, CBL, CBGa, CBP, 10-OH-HHC, THXE, THCA). With them the required primary set is 31 queries, 16 of which have an adopted run, so `make audit-youtube-coverage` reports 15 missing_compounds while the 15 collected compounds stay complete. This block is the design declaration, not a measurement: absence of a run is not a zero observation. The thirteen new terms carry no chemical identity: the query strings are registered so the requirement is visible, not because a substance was identified (ISS-20261111-TAX-040).
compound_set.coverage_rule: Two levels, both reported. Query level: a required primary query is covered when at least one adopted run carries that query_id. Compound level: a compound is complete only when all of its required primary queries are covered; some-but-not-all is `partial`, none is `missing`. One run covers only its own query_id and is never substituted for another query, and counts are never summed across queries or runs.
compound_set.identity_caveat: compound_thcnm's chemical identity is supplier/market-reported and unconfirmed. THA is an alias / commercial name of the same compound, not a second substance: both required primary queries resolve to compound_thcnm, and the two runs measure two query strings, not two substances. The query terms are the registry's canonical_text, so a run measures content matching that string, not a verified substance (ISS-20261104-TAX-028). The same caveat applies with no identity evidence at all to the thirteen terms registered on 2026-11-11: they sit in the administrative category `compound_identity_unverified`, which makes no chemical claim (ISS-20261111-TAX-040).

query_designs.retained_out_of_scope_policy: Raw payloads and declarations for out-of-primary runs stay in place as provenance. They are excluded from primary coverage counts and are never treated as a required companion run.
query_designs.rationale: This collection observes a Japanese-market product signal, not a country-limited platform count. (a) The actor input has no geo filter. (b) The Japanese product term リキッド approximates a market restriction through the query language. (c) That approximation is not a geographic guarantee. A bare compound term is not limited to Japanese product content, so it measures a different unit and is outside the primary design.
limitations: Query-language restriction is approximate: Japanese-language content about non-Japanese markets, and non-Japanese-language content about the Japanese market, are not separated.
The actor returns a search-result sample, not a census.
Out-of-primary runs do not complete coverage for any compound.

`CBC` is also an acronym outside this domain (for example the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation), so the registered string `CBC` and `CBC リキッド` measure content matching that string, not a verified substance. Neither compound has a run yet (2026-11-10), so no observed series exists to review under this caveat.

The thirteen terms registered on 2026-11-11 (THCB, THCP, THCJD, THCPO, CBE, HHCPO, CBND, CBL, CBGa, CBP, 10-OH-HHC, THXE, THCA) are registered as search strings only. Their chemical identity is unverified and the taxonomy places them in the administrative category `compound_identity_unverified`, which asserts no route, natural occurrence, chemical class, structure, synonym or regulatory status. A run for one of them would measure content matching the string, never the substance (ISS-20261111-TAX-040).

distribution.reason: The distribution slice uses the COL-033 YouTube declaration only; the raw study's YouTube runs are outside that slice. THCNM is outside the slice in every case: it has no YouTube run in this study and none in COL-033. compound_cbc and compound_cbdv are outside the slice as well: they were added to the study's registered set on 2026-11-10 and have no run in any source, so nothing about them enters a release. The thirteen terms registered on 2026-11-11 (ISS-20261111-TAX-040) are outside the slice for the same reason and their identity is unverified, so no series about them may enter a release even after collection. Registering a compound does not widen the slice.

comparison_scales.rationale: 12 ヶ月の common-scale では、窓内の最大値（CBD の 2026-05 の週 = 100）が共通スケールの分母になるため、THCNM のような低容量語は 0 に丸められる。3 ヶ月は同じアンカー CBD・THC と THCNM を 1 要求で測る日次補足系列で、分母が窓内最大値に限られるため 12 ヶ月より低容量語を分解しやすい。ただし値は 12 ヶ月 common-scale とも単独系列とも直接比較できない（別の共通スケール）。窓は収集時点の today 3-m の公称 90 日で、絶対窓の正本は metadata/windows。
